scenarios.title: 1. Verify initial header pipeline status text (pre-change)
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the pipeline status text in footer shows 'not configured' when API status is false or null before the patch.

scenarios.title: 2. Check Setup required pill when API is not ready
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the header pill text reads 'Setup required' when the API status is false before the patch.

scenarios.title: 3. Index repository context button disabled when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Validate that 'Index repository context' button is disabled when apiReady is false before patch.

scenarios.title: 4. Analyze change button disabled when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Check that 'Analyze change' button is disabled when apiReady is false prior to patch.

scenarios.title: 5. Inline setup hint visibility when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Verify setup inline message is visible instructing user to configure keys when API not ready.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
